paragraphs.text: Anim Pakal is a human of the Oltec on Ixalan , and the general of the Thousand Moons, known as the Thousandth Moon . She is the sister of Akal Pakal .
Pakal has dark hair, often held in place by a crownlike band, her khipu and belt adorned with cosmium .
When the seal at Matzalantli was opened in 5 Dawn Era , Pakal was among the first to meet the explorers.
